response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with a long track record across web, backend, embedded, and developer-tooling work, and he has genuine IDE-adjacent experience (C/C++ components for NI LabWindows/CVI) plus strong testing/craftsmanship credentials. However, the role's core requirements — deep Java and Kotlin expertise, JVM internals, and the Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate enterprise ecosystem — are largely absent. Java appears only as a peripheral skill in roles from 2016–2018, Kotlin and Spring are never mentioned, and the last decade of work is dominated by TypeScript/Node.js and DLang. The gap between his primary stack and the JVM enterprise tooling focus is too large for a mid-senior IC expected to own subsystems end-to-end from day one.
strengths: Prior IDE development experience (NI LabWindows/CVI in C/C++)
Strong tooling/OSS background: test runners, libraries, code generators
Deep testing discipline (TDD, CI/CD) and proven teaching/communication skills
concerns: No demonstrated Kotlin or Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate experience
Java listed only as a skill, with minimal hands-on evidence since 2018
Recent decade centered on TypeScript/Node and DLang, not the JVM
